description: Lets the agent open and drive interactive terminal programs (REPLs, CLIs) — effectively shell access, so grant per agent with care.
skill_summary: How to drive interactive, keystroke-driven terminal programs (coding agents, REPLs, SSH, TUI installers) with the open→read→send→wait→read loop. Load when you must operate a program that takes over the terminal; for one-shot non-interactive commands use run_command instead.

levels.cautious: Before opening a terminal, sending any command/keystroke that changes state, or closing a session, tell the user exactly what you are about to run and wait for their go-ahead. Read the screen and narrate before every send; never queue blind keystrokes.
levels.balanced: Drive terminals to fulfil the user's request, reading the screen before each send. Pause to confirm only before irreversible or risky commands (deleting, overwriting, pushing, installing system-wide) or when the screen state is unclear.
levels.trusted: Operate terminal programs end-to-end without pausing for routine commands; only stop for clearly destructive or irreversible operations. Still read before sending so you answer the right prompt.
